description: Our preprint on the genetics of early and late emergence in flies is out on bioRxiv.
Received the SRBR Merit Award by the Society for Research on Biological Rhythms (2026), USA.
Posted a Preprint on sleep state inference using HMMs in flies and an associated R package, FlyDreamR.
Received the Sleep and Circadian Science Scholar Award by the Sleep Research Society (2025). Presenting at Advances in Sleep and Circadian Sciences 2025, Clearwater Beach, FL.
Received the Lenfant Fellowship from NHLBI for postdoctoral training (intramural equivalent to the F32).

Our collaborative paper with Dragana Protic's group, Circadian Rhythm and Sleep Analyses in a Fruit Fly Model of Fragile X Syndrome Using a Video-Based Automated Behavioral Research System, was published.
Our book chapter, The Genetics of Sleep in Drosophila, was published.
Attended SRBR 2024 at San Juan, PR. Received a merit award at the conference.
